This Contempt Petition is filed alleging non- compliance of the directions of order dated 28 th February, 2019 passed in Writ Petition No. 430 of 2009.

By the operative directions, the Respondents, inter alia, were directed to pay compensation under Section 19 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition ,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as expeditiously as possible and in any case within a period of 12 months from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.

sentences.text: On behalf of the State, two affidavit in replies have been filed.
In the subsequent reply, Shri Vijayanand Tikam page 1 of 2 2- CP 582 of 2022.doc

Swanand Sharma, the Land Acquisition Officer and Sub- Divisional Officer, Malegaon, Dist. Nashik, hasstated that the Award amount has been paid to the Petitioner Shri Vishwas Namdeo Devare and to legal heirs of the deceased Nimba Devchand Chavan (land owners) on 24 th March, 2023 and 31st March, 2023 respectively via RTGS.

It is stated in paragraph no.9, of the said reply that accordingly the directions given in order dated 15th February, 2023 passed by this Court in present Contempt Petition have been complied with in all respect by Respondent - Sub Divisional Officer, Malegaon.
Hence, it is prayed that Contempt Petition be disposed of.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner also would not dispute what has been set out in the compliance affidavit.
She states that the order passed by this Court has been complied by the respondents.
4. In the above circumstances, we do not find any reason to proceed further with the contempt proceedings.
5. Hence, Contempt Petition is disposed of.
No order to costs.
[RAJESH S. PATIL,J.]
[G.S.KULKARNI,J.]
